authority.production_gate: Static/dynamic adapter allowlist; disposable full history diff permits only native commented additions.

schema.production_gate: Production parser matches these fixtures; no automatic reference resolution or evidence I/O.

identity_retry.production_gate: Native identical retry across restart/profiles is one logical record, all native occurrences retained.

concurrency_order.production_gate: Real simultaneous same-predecessor appends, concurrent definitions and retry conflicts expose ambiguity, never a winner.

diagnostics.production_gate: All diagnostic fixtures, mixed valid/invalid histories and failure responses match; no false untracked/success.

completion.production_gate: Every unfinished native status rejects observe without write; native done prerequisite and race on status change freshly checked.

results_states.production_gate: Exercise all five native persisted assessments plus planned/awaiting/untracked/invalid, independent of lifecycle.

regression.production_gate: Confirmation then regression/recovery; ancestor and criterion comparison failures; no reopen.

provenance_evidence.production_gate: Trusted native author/time; criterion coverage, baseline/artifact enforcement and explicit observation time/environment; no evidence truth guarantee.

board_fences.production_gate: Real headless/worker board routing, DB-pin-without-slug rejection and cross-profile shared-board reads.

timing.production_gate: Known native completion anchor or explicit external anchor only; earliest bound, exact due versus overdue, manual unknown, invalid anchors rejected.

limits.production_gate: 16-KiB exact UTF-8 native readback; reject oversize before mutation; 1024 comments/2-MiB history; no native allocation cap claimed.

redaction_readback.production_gate: Native stored redaction corpus, canonical checksum roundtrip/corruption after restart, malformed/changed readback, write timeout/unknown commit, read failure and concurrent post-write fork are never success; no blind retry/rollback.

no_action_followup.production_gate: Read-only check action/suggestion matrix; follow-up is text only; kanban_create/link never called.

architecture.production_gate: Review production AST/imports/dispatch, disabled/error plugin native completion, no hooks/persistence/DB/CLI fallback or private imports; not malicious-code isolation.

verification.production_gate: Canonical verification includes schema, unit, architecture and required real-runtime checks; missing dependencies/runtime fail, never skip; preserve source handoff.
